entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand tracker. It's a piece of junk and I want my money back.

I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the band or more of a preference issue?
It's a preference! I hate it. The battery is terrible and it's uncomfortable to wear. I'm not troubleshooting anything, I just want to send it back. This shouldn't be that complicated.
I understand completely. Let me just pull up your order details. I see you received the VeloBand 23 days ago, on December 15th.

And? So what? Are you telling me it's too late? This is ridiculous! Your website said nothing about that! I want to speak to your manager right now. I'm going to leave a review on every website about this scam.

Sir, there's no need for that, I can handle this for you. I just needed a moment to review the official VeloFit return policy. Sometimes with wearable devices, there are strict rules because of hygiene and sanitation concerns, so I was just making sure.
Hygiene? I barely wore the thing! Don't try to use that as an excuse. Just process the refund.

You are absolutely correct, I apologize for any confusion. I have our policy right here, and it clearly states that you have 90 days from the date of delivery for a return. You are well within that timeframe. I can process this for you right away.
Oh. Well, fine. That's what I thought. Good. So what do I do?

I have just initiated the return in our system. I am sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on your account. Simply place the VeloBand back in its original packaging, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office. Your full refund will be issued once we receive the item.
You're very welcome. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great rest of your day.
